call_points.text: Barring geopolitical crises, management expects close to 25% growth in the India business for FY27.
Ongoing capex programs across forging, casting, and products platform will total ₹800 Cr to ₹850 Cr over a 15 to 18-month period.
Restructuring of German steel business CDP Bharat Forge has been initiated and will complete by the end of calendar year 2027.
Defense order book stands close to ₹11,000 crores, supporting stable revenue accretion over the next 3 to 4 years.
FY26 order wins were ₹4,814 Cr, including ₹2,816 Cr in Defence; Defence order book ₹10,961 Cr at FY26-end.
Standalone Q4FY26 EBITDA margin 27.0%, down 30 bps QoQ as product mix changed.
Q4 PBT before exchange gain/loss rose 9.7% QoQ to ₹4,862 million on improved export performance.
₹450 Cr impairment on KPTL (E-mobility) investments taken in Q4 as global EV adoption changed significantly.
Restructuring of CDP Bharat Forge steel business initiated, expected to conclude by end of CY27.
Export CV business hit by North American inventory destocking in FY26; gradual recovery expected as restocking and production volumes aid growth.
JS Autocast FY26 topline ₹757 Cr with EBITDA ₹106 Cr (14.3% margin).

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has challenged revision of Annual Rateable Value (“ARV”) & property tax bill based on revised ARV for set of Triennial period 2004-05 to 2025-26 (extended till the date) raised by PCB which was contrary to the settlement between the Company and PCB. The decision on Appeal for certain periods filed before the Pune District Court and Writ Petition filed before Bombay High Court is pending. However, the Company has paid the entire amount demanded under protest. This litigation will not have any adverse financial impact on the Company. Property Tax from 2004-05 till FY 2019-2020 has been paid in full under protest - in event of Company succeeding in appeals - favourable impact to the tune of INR 30.50 crores. Th District Court vide Order dated 01.10.2025 has confirmed the property tax bills for the FY 2023-24 and 2024-25 and paid Rs. 24,11,08,644/- (includes interest) against Bharat Forge. However, for the remaining period, the appeals are still pending for adjudiciation.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has paid the full property tax up to FY 2025-26 along with interest under protest. Currently, the writ petition no 4293/2010 is pending before the Hon’ble Bombay High Court and the year-wise appeals are pending before the Pune District Court. The Company has filed a Writ Petition before the Bombay High Court challenging the order by which the District Court has confirmed the property tax bills for the FY 2023-24 and 2024-25 and paid Rs. 24,11,08,644/- (includes interest) against Bharat Forge. The Company has filed an appeal before the District Court challenging the property tax bill for the period 2025-2026.

Defence business margins targeted at 22-23% on a steady-state annual basis
Aerospace business to double from about ₹400 Cr in the next two years
Semiconductor business to reach USD 30-40 million in two years organically
Organic capex in India of about ₹1,800 Cr

operating_notes.text: Vikram VT 21 co-created with VRDE (DRDO) and TASL cleared MoD Technical Evaluation Committee for WH-AFV and FICV.
Bharat Forge acquired a 30% stake in Fortuna Engineering Private Limited for ₹129.60 Cr.
FY26 Defence order book ₹10,961 Cr; FY26 order wins ₹4,814 Cr including ₹2,816 Cr in Defence.
FY26 standalone export revenue ₹40,114 million, down 15.2% YoY; Americas exports fell to ₹24,872 million from ₹33,168 million.
K-Drive Mobility (wholly owned subsidiary w.e.f 1 July 2025) contributed ₹9,578 million revenue and ₹418 million EBITDA to FY26 Indian operations.
Secured long-term contract with Embraer for landing gear forgings as the first Indian supplier.
Aerospace business reached nearly 26% of Q4 non-auto industrial exports, acting as the second largest contributor.
Received CIT(A) order reducing Section 270A penalty for FY 2016-17 to ₹85.30 lakh.
Agneyastra Energetics broke ground on a 1,000-acre integrated defence manufacturing campus in Sri Sathya Sai District, Andhra Pradesh with a planned investment of ₹1,500 crore.
Signed MoU with Andhra Pradesh Government to establish India's first private-sector Marine Gas Turbine facility at Visakhapatnam across ~80 acres.
Defence order book ₹11,196 Cr at end-Q1FY27; Q1 wins ₹522 Cr forging, ₹681 Cr defence and about ₹150 Cr ferrous casting.
European business revenue ₹1,074 Cr with EBITDA ₹30 Cr (about 3% margin); US revenue ₹461 Cr with EBITDA loss ₹4 Cr.
BF CDP restructuring impact about EUR 30 million, non-cash, to be paid over six to twelve months; entity to cease by Q3 CY27.

Agneyastra Energetics Limited, incorporated July 2, 2025, is a 100% step-down subsidiary of Bharat Forge via KSSL, with nil turnover in FY26, set up for high-energy explosives, gun and rocket propellants and ammunition pour filling.

timeline.summary: Re-appointment of Mr. B. P. Kalyani (DIN: 00267202) and Mr. S. E. Tandale (DIN: 00266833) as Whole‑Time Directors designated Executive Directors approved by members on 22 April 2026.
VRDE (DRDO) and Bharat Forge flagged off co-developed Vikram VT 21 advanced armoured platforms.
Bharat Forge agreed to acquire a 30% stake in Fortuna Engineering Private Limited for ₹129.60 Cr on April 30, 2026.
BABA KALYANI (CHAIRMAN & MANAGING DIRECTOR) declared no encumbrance on Bharat Forge’s promoter group shares as of April 3, 2026, per SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,528.04 Cr (+17.5% YoY), net profit ₹233.45 Cr (-17.4% YoY).

Bharat Forge's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation (7 May 2026) reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹16,812 Cr (+11.2%) and guided FY27 Indian manufacturing operations revenue growth of 25%, with a Defence order book of ₹10,961 Cr.
Bharat Forge Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Analyst/Investor Conference Call held on May 07, 2026, after announcing audited FY26 results.
Bharat Forge secured a long-term contract with Embraer to supply landing gear forgings, becoming the first Indian supplier in Embraer's forged components supply chain.
On May 7, 2026, Bharat Forge reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹16,812 Cr and outlined a 25% growth target for its India business in FY27.
Bharat Forge received an income-tax appellate order reducing penalty for FY 2016-17 to ₹85.30 lakh.
Shareholders via postal ballot re-appointed Mr. B. P. Kalyani (DIN: 00267202) and Mr. S. E. Tandale (DIN: 00266833) as Executive Directors on April 22, 2026, with 99.28% approval.
On May 15, 2026, Bharat Forge announced that its subsidiary Agneyastra Energetics broke ground on a ₹1,500 Cr defence facility in Andhra Pradesh.
Bharat Forge signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh government on May 19, 2026, to establish India's first private-sector Marine Gas Turbine facility at Visakhapatnam.
Bharat Forge Q1FY27 consolidated revenue rose 18.7% YoY to ₹4,640 Cr with EBITDA margin at 16.2%; defence order book ₹11,196 Cr and a ₹2,500 Cr growth-capex fundraise planned.

2026-10-16: Bharat Forge invested ₹240 Cr in wholly owned Kalyani Strategic Systems via rights issue from QIP proceeds; KSSL will put ₹163 Cr of it into step-down arm Agneyastra Energetics by September 30, 2027.
